import json
import subprocess

# Test with various control characters from the range
# STX (U+0002), BEL (U+0007), VT (U+000B), SO (U+000E), etc.
test_cases = [
    ("STX (U+0002)", "name\x02field"),
    ("BEL (U+0007)", "name\x07field"),
    ("VT (U+000B)", "name\x0bfield"),
    ("SO (U+000E)", "name\x0efield"),
    ("US (U+001F)", "name\x1ffield"),
]

for desc, col_name in test_cases:
    test = {
      "pipeline": {"steps": [
        {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", col_name]}
      ]},
      "dataset": []
    }
    
    result = subprocess.run(["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
                           input=json.dumps(test),
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    if output['status'] == 'error':
        print(f"✓ {desc}: {output['error_code']}")
    else:
        print(f"✗ {desc}: SHOULD HAVE FAILED")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

# Final comprehensive test covering all validation points
test_cases = [
    ("select with valid columns", {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "name"]}, True),
    ("select with over-long column", {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "a"*65]}, False),
    ("filter with valid where", {"op": "filter", "where": "id > 5"}, True),
    ("filter with over-long where", {"op": "filter", "where": "a"*65}, False),
    ("map with valid as and expr", {"op": "map", "as": "result", "expr": "id * 2"}, True),
    ("map with over-long as", {"op": "map", "as": "a"*65, "expr": "id"}, False),
    ("map with over-long expr", {"op": "map", "as": "r", "expr": "a"*65}, False),
    ("rename with valid from/to", {"op": "rename", "from": "old", "to": "new"}, True),
    ("rename with over-long from", {"op": "rename", "from": "a"*65, "to": "new"}, False),
    ("rename with over-long to", {"op": "rename", "from": "old", "to": "a"*65}, False),
    ("rename with valid mapping", {"op": "rename", "mapping": {"old": "new"}}, True),
    ("rename with over-long mapping value", {"op": "rename", "mapping": {"old": "a"*65}}, False),
    ("limit with valid n", {"op": "limit", "n": 10}, True),
]

for desc, step, should_pass in test_cases:
    test = {"pipeline": {"steps": [step]}, "dataset": []}
    result = subprocess.run(["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
                           input=json.dumps(test),
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    
    is_valid = output['status'] == 'ok'
    status = "✓" if is_valid == should_pass else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {desc}: {'valid' if is_valid else 'invalid'}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

# Test that error paths match the requirement
test_cases = [
    # Test path format for each field type
    ("pipeline.steps[0].op", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "a"*65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].columns[1]", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "a"*65]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].where", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "filter", "where": "a"*65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].as", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "a"*65, "expr": "id"}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].expr", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "r", "expr": "a"*65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].from", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "from": "a"*65, "to": "new"}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].to", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "from": "old", "to": "a"*65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].mapping.old", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "mapping": {"old": "a"*65}}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].when", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "a"*65, "steps": []}]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].id", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"id": "a"*65, "when": "id > 5", "steps": []}]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("pipeline.steps[0].merge.strategy", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "otherwise", "steps": []}], "merge": {"strategy": "a"*65}}]}, "dataset": []}),
]

for expected_path, test in test_cases:
    result = subprocess.run(["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
                           input=json.dumps(test),
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    
    if output.get('path') == expected_path:
        print(f"✓ {expected_path}")
    else:
        print(f"✗ {expected_path} (got {output.get('path')})")
EOF
